The water utility system begins where households or businesses connect piped water into their respective infrastructure. At a municipal plant, treated water enters an expansive network of buried pipes which crisscross throughout the area serving a population. Consumers pay usage fees that are reinvested back into maintaining this vast underground piping, which delivers safe tap water. In times of peak demand, such as early morning washing routines, pressure from reservoirs ensures adequate delivery to each user through valves
